note: Every statistic this site publishes, recorded with its sample size, and compared with the previous recording. A claim that moves more than the tolerance is reported as moved, with both values - a base rate that quietly drifts is worse than one that is wrong, because nobody notices.

cautions.not_accuracy: This checks whether OUR numbers are stable, not whether the market obeys them.
cautions.drift_is_expected: Sample sizes grow as sessions accumulate, so small movement is normal. The tolerance exists so the report does not cry wolf about a tenth of a point.
cautions.history_cap: The ledger keeps the last 400 entries. Older records are dropped, never rewritten.
